name: Ura Shouma
source:
A high school student who’s a year younger than you. High school sophomore.
Moved from the mainland when he was in middle school due to his parents’ divorce. He’s taciturn and his facial expressions are not that expressive. Used to take photographs, but stopped doing so for one reason or another. Although he rarely goes to school, he shows up every day to the photography club that you, Subaru and Nachi created.

‘...This photography club just serves me as another time-killer.’

[Translated from [url=https://animal-pla.net/hoshikuzu/]the official website[/url].]
